newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Zambia govt puts Nitrogen Chemicals up for sale.
newsitem.headline: Zambia govt puts Nitrogen Chemicals up for sale.

text.p: The Zambia Privatisation Agency said on Tuesday is was seeking offers for the acquisition of at least 70 percent of Nitrogen Chemicals of Zambia Ltd (NCZ).
The company, a unit of Zambia Industrial Mining Corp, manufactures explosive grade ammonium nitrate, chemical fertilisers and industrial chemicals.

The agency said in an advertisement in the South African press that NCZ -- which has its head office and factory in Kafue, 45 km south of Lusaka -- was currently operating below capacity due to liquidity problems and was unable to meet demand for its products.
NCZ has annual turnover of about 10 billion kwacha, approximately $8 million.
